newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to sell stake in Escelsa Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to sell stake in Escelsa Monday.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said it will sell the federal government's remaining stake in privatized Espirito Santo power firm Escelsa at an auction on August 18.

BNDES will auction 666,911 common shares or 14.65 percent of Escelsa's voting capital, belonging to federal power holding company Eletrobras, for a minimum price of 162 reais per share, the bank said in a published statement.
Brazilian brokerages and banks Garantia, City Corretora de Cambio e Valores Mobiliarios, Primus and Bradesco are coordinating the sale, the statement said.
Privatized in 1995, Escelsa is controlled by a group of pension funds and Iven SA, a firm created by local and foreign investment banks and firms to invest in the Brazilian power sector.
The auction will be held at 1330 local/1630 GMT on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
